page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.large is a general-purpose virtual machine running on KVM hypervisors. It features an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor clocked at 2.7 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 instruction set. The instance allocates 1 dedicated physical core with simultaneous multithreading, providing 2 vCPUs. Memory capacity is configured at 8.0 GB (4.0 GB per core), maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Local storage is not bundled, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent disks. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps, and no GPU hardware accelerators are present. The processor includes hardware acceleration features such as AVX-512 (f, vnni, bf16) and cryptographic extensions including AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

In synthetic and real-world benchmarks, the instance demonstrates distinct behavioral characteristics. Single-core performance ranks in the top quartile, as indicated by a stress-ng single-core score of 3070.98 and a Geekbench single-core result of 1989.0. However, because the instance provides only two execution threads across a single physical core, aggregate multi-threaded benchmarks place in the lower tier, including a multi-core Geekbench score of 2479.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 3814.1. Memory bandwidth tests show moderate write throughput at 27.73 GB/sec, while cached read throughput and static web serving throughput (2.81 GB/sec) fall into lower percentile brackets. Redis SET operations reached 2.85 million ops/sec.

Given its resource profile and benchmark results, ecs.g8a.large is architecturally matched for workloads that benefit from modern x86 instructions and high single-thread efficiency rather than broad parallel processing. Its balanced memory footprint allows for reliable execution of lightweight microservices, internal tooling, staging environments, and modest web servers. Workloads requiring intensive multi-threaded batch execution, high-throughput caching, or local low-latency NVMe storage should consider higher-tier instances with multiple physical cores.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.large is a general-purpose virtual machine built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor operating at 2.7 GHz, providing 1 dedicated physical core configured with simultaneous multithreading to deliver 2 vCPUs. The instance includes 8.0 GB of system memory, matching the standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, and operates with a 2 Gbps baseline network connection. The server does not bundle local disk storage or hardware GPU acceleration, requiring remote block storage for persistence. In benchmarks, the single physical core delivers strong single-core compute capabilities in Geekbench and stress-ng tests. However, overall multi-core throughput, static web serving, and database operations reflect the modest two-thread ceiling. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.large is suited for low-concurrency application backends, basic web serving, development environments, and small-scale background task execution.
